Definition: diminutive from the same as G2339; a dangerous animal:--(venomous, wild) beast.
BiblicalUsage: thēríon is the Bible's word for a wild beast. In Mark 1:13, he was there in the wilderness forty days. The word turns up 38 times, and each time it points to the same reality.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the beast that rises against God’s people is real, but its end is already written. That is why I come back to thēríon whenever I need to remember what is true.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
